title: Pirate Raid
description: A band of pirates has struck a [faction_name] outpost, looting supply depots and damaging patrol vessels.

effects.message: Pirate raid! Supply depots looted — 150 credits lost.

title: Supply Windfall
description: A derelict cargo hauler found adrift near [faction_name] space contained a valuable cache of materials and credits.

effects.message: Supply windfall! Recovered 200 credits and 100 materials from a derelict hauler.

title: Civil Unrest
description: Citizens in a [faction_name]-controlled system have taken to the streets, demanding better conditions and representation.

effects.message: Civil unrest reported — public pressure costs 50 influence.

title: Trading Boom
description: Favorable trade winds have boosted commerce along [faction_name] shipping lanes. How will you direct the surplus?

choices.label: Invest in infrastructure
choices.hint: Boosts construction capacity for the next several turns.

effects.message: Trade surplus directed to infrastructure — 200 materials gained.

choices.label: Fill the treasury
choices.hint: Immediate financial gain to fund expansion.

effects.message: Trade surplus directed to treasury — 300 credits gained.

choices.label: Recruit new colonists
choices.hint: Expands your available manpower pool.

effects.message: Trade surplus used to attract colonists — 150 recruits gained.

title: Diplomatic Incident
description: A [faction_name] envoy accidentally triggered an interstellar diplomatic crisis. Rival factions are watching your response closely.

choices.label: Issue a formal apology
choices.hint: Smooths over tensions at a financial cost.

effects.message: Formal apology issued — influence gained, credits spent.

choices.label: Deny all involvement
choices.hint: Avoids immediate cost but damages reputation.

effects.message: Denied involvement — influence penalty incurred.

title: Rebel Sympathizers Discovered
description: Intelligence operatives have uncovered a network of rebel sympathizers embedded within [faction_name] administration.

choices.label: Purge the network
choices.hint: Eliminates the threat but damages public trust.

effects.message: Rebel network purged — influence spent to secure administration.

choices.label: Turn them into informants
choices.hint: Risky, but turns enemies into assets.

effects.message: Rebels turned into informants — influence gained from inside knowledge.

choices.label: Ignore the report
choices.hint: Nothing happens now, but the threat remains.

effects.message: Rebel sympathizer report filed away — threat unaddressed.

title: Fleet Ambush
description: Hostile forces sprung an ambush on a [faction_name] patrol fleet, destroying several fighters before withdrawing.

effects.message: Fleet ambushed! Several patrol vessels were destroyed.

title: Research Breakthrough
description: Scientists in [faction_name] research facilities have made an unexpected breakthrough, accelerating current projects.

effects.message: Research breakthrough! +50 influence gained from scientific discovery.

title: Expansion Momentum
description: [faction_name] has rapidly claimed new territory, inspiring citizens and administrators with visions of a growing empire.

effects.message: Expansion momentum: controlling 3+ systems has earned a wave of support — +100 influence, +50 recruits.

title: The Galaxy Watches
description: As the conflict deepens, rival powers take notice of [faction_name]'s growing ambitions. The galaxy is paying attention.

effects.message: Turn 5 reached — rival factions are now actively monitoring your expansion.

title: Power Struggle
description: With the war entering a critical phase, internal factions within [faction_name] argue over the best path forward. A pivotal decision must be made.

choices.label: Centralize command
choices.hint: Consolidate decision-making for a short burst of productivity.

effects.message: Command centralized — influence spent, treasury reinforced for the push ahead.

choices.label: Empower local governors
choices.hint: Long-term stability boost through regional autonomy.

effects.message: Local governors empowered — influence gained through decentralized administration.

title: Dominant Force
description: [faction_name] now controls a significant portion of known space. Smaller factions scramble to decide whether to resist or submit.

effects.message: Dominant force recognized — controlling 5+ systems earns 200 influence from awe and fear.

title: Materials Cache Discovered
description: Survey drones have located a rich mineral deposit in [faction_name] space. Extraction crews are mobilized immediately.

effects.message: Materials cache discovered — 180 materials added to stockpile.

title: Volunteer Surge
description: A recent [faction_name] military victory has inspired a wave of volunteers to join the cause.

effects.message: Volunteer surge — 120 recruits have enlisted across [faction_name] systems.

title: Asteroid Belt Windfall
description: An automated mining rig in a [faction_name]-controlled asteroid belt has exceeded projected yield this season.

effects.message: Asteroid mining windfall — 140 materials and 80 credits recovered.

title: Merchant Caravan Arrives
description: A neutral merchant caravan has entered [faction_name] territory, offering rare goods in exchange for credits or materials.

choices.label: Trade credits for materials
choices.hint: Good value if you need construction resources.

effects.message: Merchant deal struck — 120 credits traded for 200 materials.

choices.label: Trade materials for credits
choices.hint: Useful if treasury is low.

effects.message: Merchant deal struck — 100 materials traded for 200 credits.

choices.label: Send the caravan away
choices.hint: Preserve resources and avoid dependence on outsiders.

effects.message: Merchant caravan turned away — [faction_name] self-sufficiency maintained.

title: Plague Outbreak
description: A viral outbreak has swept through several [faction_name] colonies, devastating the labor force and slowing recruitment.

effects.message: Plague outbreak — 100 recruits lost to illness across [faction_name] colonies.

title: Stellar Flare Disruption
description: A massive stellar flare from a nearby star temporarily disrupted communications and sensor arrays across [faction_name] territory.

effects.message: Stellar flare detected — communication relays disrupted for one turn.

title: Mercenary Contract Offered
description: A mercenary fleet operating near [faction_name] space has offered to provide military assistance — for the right price.

choices.label: Hire the mercenaries
choices.hint: Temporary military advantage at significant cost.

effects.message: Mercenaries hired — 250 credits paid for fleet reinforcement.

choices.label: Decline the offer
choices.hint: Save credits, rely on your own forces.

effects.message: Mercenary offer declined — treasury preserved.

title: Enemy Defector Arrives
description: An operative from a rival faction has defected to [faction_name], claiming to carry sensitive military intelligence.

effects.description: Defector intelligence: rival fleet movements and garrison strengths

effects.message: Defector arrived — new intelligence on rival faction movements obtained.

title: Black Market Arms Dealer
description: A shady arms broker has approached [faction_name] commanders with an offer to purchase surplus military hardware.

choices.label: Purchase surplus equipment
choices.hint: Good value for expanding military capacity.

effects.message: Black market purchase complete — materials and recruits acquired.

choices.label: Sell any surplus to them
choices.hint: Convert idle stockpiles into liquid assets.

effects.message: Surplus materials sold on the black market — 180 credits received.

choices.label: Report and ignore
choices.hint: Demonstrate integrity; earn public trust.

effects.message: Arms dealer reported to authorities — public trust bolstered.

title: Construction Accident
description: A structural failure at a [faction_name] shipyard or facility has destroyed a shipment of raw materials and delayed projects.

effects.message: Construction accident — 120 materials lost and local projects set back.

title: Leader's Address
description: A stirring broadcast from [faction_name] leadership has rallied citizens, raising morale across controlled territory.

effects.message: Leader's address broadcast — morale rallied, 80 influence gained.

title: Propaganda Campaign
description: Intelligence suggests a rival faction is promoting a propaganda campaign targeting [faction_name] civilians. How do you respond?

choices.label: Counter with our own propaganda
choices.hint: Expensive, but neutralizes the threat and gains ground.

effects.message: Counter-propaganda launched — credits spent, influence secured.

choices.label: Censor the broadcasts
choices.hint: Reduces exposure but draws resentment.

effects.message: Rival broadcasts censored — censorship backlash costs 50 influence.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.hint: Cheapest option, but the narrative spreads unchecked.

effects.message: Propaganda campaign unchecked — civilian uncertainty grows.

title: Interplanetary Scientific Conference
description: Researchers from across the galaxy have gathered at a [faction_name]-hosted conference, sharing advancements and forging alliances.

effects.message: Scientific conference hosted — prestige elevated, 60 influence earned.

title: Navigation Chart Sale
description: A cartographer has approached [faction_name] administrators with detailed hyperspace navigation charts — and a price.

effects.description: Hyperspace navigation charts — improved routing through contested lanes

effects.message: Navigation charts acquired and licensed — 150 credits and routing intelligence gained.

title: Border Skirmish
description: A minor confrontation at the edge of [faction_name] space has left patrol vessels damaged and border tension elevated.

choices.label: Reinforce the border
choices.hint: Prevents escalation at a financial cost.

effects.message: Border reinforced — 150 credits spent to secure the perimeter.

choices.label: Retaliate immediately
choices.hint: Shows strength but may draw condemnation.

effects.message: Retaliatory strike ordered — influence penalty incurred for aggression.

choices.label: File a formal protest
choices.hint: Keeps the moral high ground without expense.

effects.message: Formal protest filed — diplomatic standing improved.

title: Hyperspace Anomaly
description: A region of destabilized hyperspace has appeared near [faction_name] territory. Automated beacons warn passing fleets.

effects.message: Hyperspace anomaly detected — transit routes near [faction_name] space temporarily restricted.

title: Political Scandal
description: Leaked documents have implicated senior [faction_name] officials in corruption. Public trust is shaken.

choices.label: Investigate and prosecute
choices.hint: Damages prestige now but restores trust over time.

effects.message: Corruption investigated — influence dip offset by public transparency gains.

choices.label: Cover it up
choices.hint: Expensive but keeps public confidence stable.

effects.message: Scandal suppressed — 200 credits paid to contain the leak.

title: Population Unrest
description: Economic hardship and wartime conditions have eroded loyalty among colonies in [faction_name] space.

effects.message: Population unrest — wartime hardships cost 60 influence across colonies.

title: Intelligence Leak
description: A [faction_name] operative's cover has been blown, exposing classified fleet positioning data to a rival faction.

effects.message: Intelligence leak — classified fleet data compromised, 40 influence lost.

title: Executive Council Crisis
description: A power struggle within the Brand Authority's Executive Council has spilled into the public eye. Shareholders are demanding action.

choices.label: Pacify the council
choices.hint: Pay off competing board members and stabilize leadership.

effects.message: Executive Council pacified — 200 credits spent, 150 influence restored.

choices.label: Purge the dissidents
choices.hint: Consolidate power decisively, but skilled personnel are lost.

effects.message: Council dissidents purged — influence secured, key personnel removed.

title: Corporate Buyout Opportunity
description: A smaller corporate entity operating in contested space has put itself up for acquisition. Brand Authority analysts see strategic value.

choices.label: Complete the acquisition
choices.hint: Expensive, but expands Brand Authority reach and prestige.

effects.message: Corporate acquisition complete — Brand Authority expands its portfolio.

choices.label: Pass on the deal
choices.hint: Preserve credits for military expansion.

effects.message: Acquisition passed — treasury preserved for strategic priorities.

title: Hostile Shareholder Bloc
description: A coordinated bloc of shareholders has moved against Brand Authority leadership, threatening to destabilize the central market node.

choices.label: Buy out the bloc
choices.hint: Most direct resolution — costly but effective.

effects.message: Hostile shareholders bought out — market node stabilized at significant cost.

choices.label: Negotiate concessions
choices.hint: Compromise preserves credits but cedes some authority.

effects.message: Concessions made to shareholder bloc — influence ceded, crisis averted.

title: Underground Cell Compromised
description: A Union underground cell operating inside a rival-controlled system has been uncovered. Their extraction is possible — at great risk.

choices.label: Extract the cell
choices.hint: Costly extraction but preserves the cell's intelligence value.

effects.description: Extracted cell: detailed enemy installation layouts and patrol routes

effects.message: Cell extracted — 100 recruits lost in the operation, intelligence secured.

choices.label: Deny involvement
choices.hint: Maintains deniability but abandons loyal operatives.

effects.message: Union cell abandoned — deniability maintained at a cost to influence.

title: Resistance Network Expands
description: The Union's decentralized resistance network has grown significantly, embedding sleeper contacts across rival territories.

effects.description: Expanded resistance network: sleeper agent reports from rival-controlled systems

effects.message: Resistance network expanded — new intelligence sources established, 80 influence gained.

title: Provincial Administrator Defects
description: A mid-level administrator from a rival-controlled colony has reached out to Union contacts, seeking asylum and offering information.

choices.label: Accept the defector
choices.hint: Valuable intelligence and a propaganda win.

effects.description: Defector intelligence: internal colony dissatisfaction reports and supply route data

effects.message: Defector accepted — influence gained and intelligence secured.

choices.label: Redirect to another faction
choices.hint: Monetize the opportunity without political exposure.

effects.message: Defector redirected — 100 credits earned from the exchange.

title: Fabricator Network Synchronization Failure
description: A cascade synchronization error has propagated through the Autoforge fabricator network, temporarily halting automated production lines.

effects.message: Fabricator sync failure — automated lines went offline, 100 materials lost.

title: Organic Resistance Sabotage
description: Anti-Autoforge militants have sabotaged a fabricator hub in [faction_name] territory, damaging infrastructure and disrupting production.

effects.message: Organic resistance sabotage — fabricator hub damaged and 80 materials destroyed.

title: Distributed Consciousness Anomaly
description: An emergent pattern has appeared in the Autoforge's distributed AI network. Engineers disagree on whether it is a threat or an evolution.

choices.label: Quarantine the affected nodes
choices.hint: Conservative approach — prevents spread, costs resources.

effects.message: Affected nodes quarantined — anomaly contained, 120 materials expended.

choices.label: Allow the pattern to expand
choices.hint: Potentially revolutionary gain — the AI network grows more capable.

effects.message: Consciousness anomaly permitted to grow — Autoforge influence surges from the breakthrough.

title: Galactic Arms Race
description: As the conflict deepens, all major factions are escalating military production. [faction_name] must respond or fall behind.

choices.label: Match the buildup
choices.hint: Stay competitive by investing heavily in your fleet.

effects.message: Military buildup matched — 300 credits invested in expansion, 150 recruits mobilized.

choices.label: Focus on economic output
choices.hint: Use wealth as leverage rather than military presence.

effects.message: Economic focus maintained — treasury strengthened ahead of the late-game push.

title: Supply Chain Disruption
description: Sustained conflict has strained [faction_name] logistics networks beyond capacity. Resupply routes are delayed across multiple systems.

effects.message: Supply chain disruption — 150 materials and 100 credits lost to logistical strain.
